screening_decisions.reason: Review article summarizing packing materials; not an RCT comparing steroid-eluting stents.
Retrospective review of operative findings; not an RCT and does not compare steroid-eluting stents.
Prospective controlled trial comparing revision ESS vs primary ESS; does not involve steroid-eluting stents.
RCT comparing levobupivacaine-soaked packs vs saline-soaked packs; levobupivacaine is not a steroid.
RCT comparing doxycycline-releasing stents vs placebo stents; doxycycline is an antibiotic, not a steroid.
RCT of steroid-eluting implants for IN-OFFICE treatment of recurrent polyposis AFTER ESS, not during FESS. Does not meet timing criterion.
Cross-sectional epidemiological survey; not an RCT.
Review article on pathogenesis; not an RCT.
RCT comparing dexamethasone (steroid) Sinu-Foam spacer vs placebo Sinu-Foam alone in CRS patients undergoing ESS. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing lidocaine-soaked packs vs saline-soaked packs; lidocaine is not a steroid.
RCT comparing hyaluronic acid dressing vs Merocel packing; neither is steroid-eluting.
Position paper/guideline document; not an RCT.
RCT comparing gloved vs ungloved Merocel spacers; neither is steroid-eluting.
Epidemiological prevalence study; not an RCT.
RCT comparing mometasone furoate (steroid)-releasing implants vs non-drug-releasing implants in CRS patients undergoing bilateral ethmoidectomy. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing triamcinolone (steroid)-impregnated absorbable dressing vs saline-impregnated dressing in CRS patients undergoing ESS. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing PA pack vs PA pack in glove finger; neither is steroid-eluting.
Prospective review of surgical failures; not an RCT.
Review article on etiology; not an RCT.
RCT comparing triamcinolone (steroid)-impregnated bioresorbable dressing vs saline-impregnated dressing in CRS patients undergoing ESS. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing Nasopore vs Merocel in glove finger; neither is steroid-eluting.
Meta-analysis of 2 RCTs; not a primary RCT itself.
RCT comparing hylan gel vs control; hylan gel is not steroid-eluting.
RCT comparing triamcinolone (steroid)-impregnated absorbable gelatin dressing vs normal saline in CRS patients undergoing FESS. Meets all criteria.
Retrospective analysis of scarring; not an RCT.
RCT comparing drug-eluting (steroid) stents vs non-drug-eluting stents in CRS patients undergoing FESS. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing hyaluronan resorbable packing vs non-resorbable dressing; neither is steroid-eluting.
Commentary/review on outcomes; not an RCT.
Single-cohort trial without control group; not an RCT.
RCT comparing hyaluronic acid packs vs no packing; neither is steroid-eluting.
RCT comparing nonabsorbable packing vs saline irrigations; neither is steroid-eluting.
Prevalence survey study; not an RCT.
RCT comparing triamcinolone (steroid)-impregnated bioabsorbable dressing vs saline-impregnated dressing in CRS patients undergoing ESS. Meets all criteria.
RCT comparing systemic prednisone vs placebo in patients who ALREADY received steroid-eluting spacers. Tests systemic steroids, not the stent comparison.
RCT comparing tranexamic acid pledgets vs phenylephrine pledgets; TXA is not a steroid.
Review article on stents; not an RCT.
RCT comparing hyaluronic acid hydrogel vs CMC foam; neither is steroid-eluting.
